name: Paste Manga X
tagline: Read manga and comics from your phone, free and open
description:
Paste Manga X is a third-party manga reading app that lets you browse and read comics on your phone. It is built with a modern Compose and native mixed interface, so pages load quickly and browsing feels smooth.

It is a community-built alternative client, made by fans who wanted a faster and more open way to enjoy manga on Android.
